purpose: Assigned values for the 8-bit profile_id field for the UWB binding.

allocation_policy.0x00: Reserved. Never assigned, so an uninitialised field names no profile.

profiles.name: RESERVED
profiles.detail: Permanently reserved. An offer carrying profile_id 0 is malformed.

not_assigned: No profile is assigned for UWB. The binding is unit-tested C99 that has never met UWB hardware, so there is no behaviour for a profile to describe and nothing an implementer could conform to. Assigning a value now would advertise interoperable support that does not exist. This registry exists to say that explicitly rather than leave the question open.
notes: Ranging measurements carried by this binding are proximity EVIDENCE and never proof of co-presence. A relay forwards a real exchange unmodified and defeats a proximity claim without breaking any cryptography. See mcl-uwb.
An implementation receiving an unassigned profile_id MUST NOT guess. It refuses the offer and may continue on its current transport.
